issues.label: Subject-matter jurisdiction
issues.why: The court must confirm it has statutory authority to grant the divorce and divide property and support.

issues.label: Personal jurisdiction over parties
issues.why: The court must ensure both spouses are properly before it for binding property and support orders.

issues.label: Venue and residency requirements
issues.why: Ohio divorce residency/venue prerequisites must be satisfied for a valid decree.

issues.label: Final appealable order completeness
issues.why: All claims (property, support, restraining orders, valuations) must be fully resolved and journalized to create a final decree.

issues.label: Effect of pretrial stipulations
issues.why: The court must determine which stipulations bind it (e.g., $96M Vora Ventures value) and their scope.

issues.label: Enforceability of valuation stipulation
issues.why: The court must decide whether any stipulation can be disregarded for fraud, mistake, or manifest injustice.

issues.label: Classification: marital vs separate
issues.why: Each asset and debt must be classified under R.C. 3105.171 as marital, separate, or mixed.

issues.label: Valuation date selection
issues.why: The court must choose appropriate de facto termination date(s) and valuation dates (including disputed Goldman Sachs dates).

issues.label: Equitable division factors
issues.why: The court must apply R.C. 3105.171(C),(F) factors to reach an equitable (often equal) division.

issues.label: Tracing and commingling
issues.why: If any asset has mixed sources, the court must trace separate components or deem them marital if untraceable.

issues.label: Marital debt allocation
issues.why: Debts must be identified, valued, and allocated equitably, including business-related obligations.

issues.label: Foreign assets inclusion
issues.why: The court must decide how to treat assets located in India within the Ohio marital estate despite enforcement limits.

issues.label: Currency conversion method
issues.why: The court must choose and clearly state the USD/INR conversion approach and exchange-rate date(s).

issues.label: Foreign law notice adequacy
issues.why: Civ.R. 44.1 requires reasonable notice and proof to apply Indian law on HUF issues.

issues.label: Determining foreign law content
issues.why: The court must ascertain Indian HUF law (creation, transfer formalities, beneficiary interests) as a question of law.

issues.label: HUF creation validity
issues.why: The court must decide whether MV HUF was properly created under Indian law and evidence.

issues.label: HUF asset-transfer formalities
issues.why: The court must determine what acts/title changes are legally required to transfer property into an HUF.

issues.label: AnuPriya HUF transfer validity
issues.why: It must decide whether Mahendra’s declarations transferred AnuPriya to the HUF despite title in his name.

issues.label: SGV shares HUF transfer validity
issues.why: It must decide whether Mahendra effectively assigned SGV shares to the HUF and when.

issues.label: Bank of Baroda account ownership
issues.why: The court must determine whether the account is HUF property or marital property and how to divide it.

issues.label: Member vs coparcener rights
issues.why: Sangita’s rights as an HUF member (no vested interest) affect whether HUF assets are reachable as marital property.

issues.label: Marital characterization of HUF assets
issues.why: Even if in an HUF, the court must decide whether assets remain marital due to marital funding and equitable principles.

issues.label: Fraudulent conveyance concerns
issues.why: The court must consider whether transfers to HUF or others were intended to defeat marital rights.

issues.label: Third-party interest limitations
issues.why: The court must avoid adjudicating daughters’/trusts’ rights without joinder while still valuing spouses’ marital interests.

issues.label: Joinder/necessary parties
issues.why: If relief would impair the daughters’ trusts or corporate interests, the court must consider joinder or limit remedies.

issues.label: Corporate structure deference
issues.why: The court must decide whether it can or should treat operating-agreement allocations as controlling for property division.

issues.label: Ability to unwind transfers
issues.why: The court must consider whether it has authority to set aside inter vivos gifts or instead compensate via distributive award.

issues.label: Financial misconduct standard
issues.why: R.C. 3105.171(E)(4) requires determining whether a spouse committed dissipation, concealment, or fraudulent disposition.

issues.label: Findings on misconduct allegations
issues.why: The court must make sufficient factual findings on claimed dissipation via Vora Ventures transfers to permit review.

issues.label: Knowledge/consent to gifts
issues.why: Whether Sangita knowingly consented (signatures, discussions) affects validity of gifts and misconduct analysis.

issues.label: Timing of gift transfers
issues.why: Whether transfers occurred pre-separation or as divorce planning (gift-tax return timing vs documents) bears on intent and fairness.

issues.label: Credibility determinations
issues.why: Conflicting testimony from spouses and adult daughters requires explicit credibility resolution affecting key findings.

issues.label: Undated/record integrity issues
issues.why: The court must assess authenticity and timing of documents alleged to be created to backdate transfers.

issues.label: Gift tax returns evidentiary weight
issues.why: The court must decide how federal gift-tax filings corroborate or contradict claimed transfer dates and amounts.

issues.label: Characterization of transfers (gift/charity)
issues.why: The court must determine whether transfers were bona fide estate planning gifts or improper diversions of marital property.

issues.label: Valuing Vora Ventures marital portion
issues.why: Given stipulated enterprise value and shifted ownership, the court must compute the spouses’ divisible interest correctly.

issues.label: Effect of daughters’ trust assignments
issues.why: Assignments by daughters to nonmarital trusts affect whether shares are reachable and how marital equity is addressed.

issues.label: Alternative remedy: unequal division
issues.why: If misconduct is found, the court must consider compensatory unequal division or distributive award and amount.

issues.label: AnuPriya valuation methodology
issues.why: The court must choose between competing appraisals and ensure the chosen valuation is supported and reasoned.

issues.label: SGV Plot valuation methodology
issues.why: The court must decide which expert valuation is credible and how to value a minority interest in a land-holding JV.

issues.label: Minority/marketability discounts
issues.why: Valuation of a 15% interest may require discounts or justification for not applying them under the chosen method.

issues.label: SGV partner-maintenance debt
issues.why: The court must determine existence, amount, and marital allocation of the claimed 87,472,943-rupee obligation.

issues.label: Setoff against SGV value
issues.why: If the debt is valid, the court must decide whether and how it reduces the marital value of the SGV interest.

issues.label: Business liquidity/cash flow realities
issues.why: Payment schedules and restraints must account for closely-held business liquidity without unfairly shifting risk to Sangita.

issues.label: Property equalization payment structure
issues.why: The court must decide whether installment payments are equitable versus immediate distribution or security.

issues.label: Interest on deferred payments
issues.why: The court must determine whether interest is required to make Sangita whole and what rate and accrual schedule apply.

issues.label: Authority for interest rate
issues.why: The court must ground the chosen interest/no-interest periods in statute, equity, or precedent to avoid abuse of discretion.

issues.label: Security for payment obligation
issues.why: The court must consider liens, collateral, guarantees, or restraints to secure long-term payments owed to Sangita.

issues.label: Restraint on Vora Ventures transfers
issues.why: The court must ensure any injunction restricting Mahendra’s transfers is lawful, specific, and not overbroad.

issues.label: Enforceability of restraint order
issues.why: The court must consider practical enforceability and compliance mechanisms for the no-transfer restriction.

issues.label: Sale-proceeds sharing provision
issues.why: If included, the court must define triggers, accounting, timing, and caps for Sangita’s share of net sale proceeds.

issues.label: Tax consequences of division
issues.why: The court must consider tax impacts of asset division, installment payments, and potential business sales under R.C. 3105.171(F).

issues.label: Tax consequences of support
issues.why: The court must account for post-2018 federal tax treatment of spousal support when setting amount and structure.

issues.label: Double-counting income/asset value
issues.why: The court must avoid using the same business value both to divide property and to impute income for support unfairly.

issues.label: Spousal support entitlement
issues.why: The court must decide whether support is appropriate notwithstanding large property awards under R.C. 3105.18.

issues.label: Spousal support amount factors
issues.why: All R.C. 3105.18(C)(1) factors (income, earning ability, duration, standard of living, contributions) must be weighed.

issues.label: Duration and termination of support
issues.why: The decree must specify duration, termination events, and any retention of jurisdiction to modify.

issues.label: Imputation of income to Sangita
issues.why: The court must decide whether to impute income based on education, employability, and long absence from workforce.

issues.label: Mahendra income determination
issues.why: The court must determine Mahendra’s true income (salary, distributions, perks) versus business reinvestment.

issues.label: Health insurance and medical costs
issues.why: Support-related orders must address coverage and allocation of uninsured medical expenses if relevant.

issues.label: Findings sufficiency for review
issues.why: The court must provide adequate reasoning on key contested issues (misconduct, valuations, payment plan) to permit appellate review.

issues.label: Treatment of adult children issues
issues.why: No custody/child support applies, but the court must ensure gifts to adult children are treated properly as third-party transfers.

issues.label: Discovery/evidence admissibility
issues.why: The court must resolve admissibility of expert reports, foreign documents, translations, and authentication issues.

issues.label: Expert qualification and reliability
issues.why: The court must determine whether valuation experts and foreign-law experts are qualified and their methods reliable.

issues.label: Translation and interpretation accuracy
issues.why: Foreign-language documents and Indian-law concepts must be accurately translated and explained to avoid factual/legal error.

issues.label: Exchange-rate evidence support
issues.why: The chosen conversion rate must be supported by record evidence and tied to the valuation/transfer date.

issues.label: Post-decree implementation clarity
issues.why: The final decree must unambiguously state amounts, deadlines, exchange rates, and mechanisms to prevent future disputes.

issues.label: Contempt/collection remedies
issues.why: The court must consider and preserve enforcement mechanisms for payment defaults (contempt, execution, QDRO-like tools if any).

issues.label: Limits of extraterritorial enforcement
issues.why: The court must consider practical enforceability of orders affecting Indian real estate or entities and craft workable relief.
